links_notes.trail:Phineas Forest (bottom) -> trail:S: 2026-11-24: Phineas Forest (glade) ends about 500 m short of the run-out the Outback Bowl map shows it flowing into; joined downhill (1289 m to 1262 m) to the bottom of Springboard, which leads to the Outback Inn base
links_notes.Colburn Triple (top) -> Great Escape Qua: 2026-11-24: both lifts end at the Sky House on the summit (about 180 m apart); from the Great Escape top the Great Divide leads back to the village, so the Outback Bowl lifts (Colburn, Cedar Park, Stella, Idyle Our T-Bar) are joined to the front side here; before, no way led back from the back side
